items_flat.title_en: Trump names a Super Intelligence Force to coordinate federal AI policy
items_flat.title_zh: 川普宣布「超級智能專案小組」協調聯邦 AI 政策
items_flat.summary_en: The Washington Post reported that on Oct 4 President Trump said on Truth Social he would name four officials to a Super Intelligence Force: DNI Jay Clayton, FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, OPM Director Scott Kupor and Emil Michael. The post framed the body as coordinating federal engagement with companies, infrastructure providers and public groups so the US leads in super intelligence.
items_flat.summary_zh: 華盛頓郵報報導，川普 10 月 4 日在 Truth Social 表示將指派國家情報總監 Jay Clayton、FTC 主席 Andrew Ferguson、人事管理局局長 Scott Kupor 與 Emil Michael 組成「超級智能專案小組」，協調聯邦與企業、基礎設施及公眾團體的往來。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move is policy coordination, not a lab shipment, and it sits next to Musk’s SI rename. Its power depends on whether the named officials get a real mandate or only a messaging forum.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是政策協調而非實驗室出貨，並與馬斯克的 SI 改名同一脈絡。實際效力取決於這四人是否有授權，或只是訊息平台。
items_flat.quote: The Super Intelligence Force is tasked with coordinating the effort of the Federal Government to ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 超級智能專案小組的任務，是協調聯邦政府的努力，確保美國繼續在超級智能領域領先世界。

items_flat.title_en: Musk says SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱 SpaceXAI 將改名 SpaceXSI
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI did not publish a rebrand page. On Oct 4, Elon Musk posted “No more AI / SI / It’s better,” called SpaceX a super intelligence company, and replied “Yes, we will make that change” when asked if SpaceXAI would become SpaceXSI. Forbes and Fox Business reported that the site and accounts still said SpaceXAI, with no timeline.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 並未發布正式改名頁。10 月 4 日馬斯克發文寫「不再叫 AI，SI 更好」，並在被問是否改名 SpaceXSI 時回覆「會做這個改變」。Forbes 與 Fox Business 指出官網與帳號當時仍是 SpaceXAI，也沒有時程。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an executive branding commitment tied to the White House’s super-intelligence wording, not a shipped product or model. Until domains, accounts and contracts change, SpaceXAI remains the operating name.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是配合白宮「超級智能」用詞的品牌表態，不是新產品或新模型。在網域、帳號與合約改完之前，營運名稱仍是 SpaceXAI。
items_flat.quote: Yes, we will make that change.
items_flat.quote_zh: 會的，我們會做這個改變。

items_flat.title_en: NYC Council sets an Oct 5 AI hearing with labs and a former Anthropic researcher
items_flat.title_zh: 紐約市議會 10 月 5 日聽證 AI，前 Anthropic 研究員將出庭
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg reported on Oct 4 that former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon will testify Monday at a New York City Council Committee of the Whole hearing, alongside representatives of major AI companies. Speaker Julie Menin requested the session as the council weighs safeguard bills; the hearing itself had not yet happened at digest time.
items_flat.summary_zh: 彭博 10 月 4 日報導，前 Anthropic 研究員 Jacob Coxon 將於週一出席紐約市議會全體委員會聽證，並與主要 AI 公司代表同場。議長 Julie Menin 要求召開此會以審議保障法案；截稿時聽證尚未舉行。
items_flat.analysis_en: A city hearing cannot set national model rules, but sworn testimony from a departing safety researcher and lab representatives will put public claims on the record. What the companies actually concede is still unknown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 市級聽證無法訂定全國模型規則，但離職安全研究員與實驗室代表的證詞會留下公開紀錄。各公司實際讓步什麼仍未知。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic asks Claude users to opt in to voice-data training
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 請 Claude 使用者選擇是否用語音資料訓練
items_flat.summary_en: BleepingComputer reported on Oct 4 that Claude’s voice features now prompt users to allow audio recordings and voice chats to improve Anthropic models, with an Allow or Not now choice and a separate Privacy toggle. The setting was described as off by default and separate from the existing chat and coding training opt-in.
items_flat.summary_zh: BleepingComputer 10 月 4 日報導，Claude 語音功能開始詢問使用者是否允許錄音與語音對話用來改進模型，可選允許或稍後，並在隱私設定另有開關。該選項據稱預設關閉，且與既有聊天與程式訓練同意分開。
items_flat.analysis_en: The change matters because Anthropic previously deleted voice audio after transcription. It is opt-in, but there is no Anthropic newsroom post in the window confirming retention periods or who is in scope.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點在於 Anthropic 先前會在轉寫後刪除語音。這次是選擇加入，但窗口內沒有新聞室貼文確認保存期限與適用對象。
items_flat.quote: Allow us to use your voice data to improve our AI models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 允許我們使用你的語音資料來改進 AI 模型。

items_flat.title_en: Musk says Grok 4.7 is number one on the AA Cyber Index
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱 Grok 4.7 在 AA 網路指數排名第一
items_flat.summary_en: xAI did not announce a new model. On Oct 4 Musk quote-posted a claim that Grok 4.7 xHigh ranked first on Artificial Analysis’ Cyber Index and wrote “Grok 4.7 is #1 on the AA Cyber Index.” Artificial Analysis’ Sept 28 launch thread scored Grok 4.7 and MiMo-V2.6-Pro in a tie at 56, with Grok’s reported cost per task far higher.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 沒有發布新模型。10 月 4 日馬斯克轉引 Grok 4.7 xHigh 在 Artificial Analysis 網路指數居首的說法，並寫下「Grok 4.7 是 AA 網路指數第一」。AA 9 月 28 日公布時，Grok 4.7 與 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 以 56 分並列，且 Grok 單次任務成本高出許多。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is an executive amplification of a two-week-old third-party board, not a release. A tie at 56 does not by itself show Grok ahead of Opus 5.5 or Astra on every subscore, and the cost gap is the practical constraint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是高層放大兩週前的第三方榜單，不是新發布。56 分並列不能單獨證明 Grok 在每個子項都領先 Opus 5.5 或 Astra，成本差距才是實務限制。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.7 is #1 on the AA Cyber Index
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 在 AA 網路指數排名第一。

items_flat.title_en: Musk highlights Farmersville’s plan to draft council minutes with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克轉發 Farmersville 用 Grok 起草市議會紀錄
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI/xAI did not announce a government product. On Oct 4 Musk quote-posted a report that Farmersville, California, voted 4-1 on Sept 29 to have Grok draft verbatim council minutes from recordings, with the city clerk proofreading them. The Sun-Gazette reported the service at $30 a month.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI／xAI 沒有宣布政府產品。10 月 4 日馬斯克轉發報導：加州 Farmersville 9 月 29 日以 4 比 1 通過，由 Grok 依錄音起草逐字會議紀錄，再由市書記校對。The Sun-Gazette 報導服務費為每月 30 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a small civic workflow trial, not a lab shipment. A human clerk remains in the loop, so accuracy and public-record liability are still local, not solved by the quote-post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是小型市政流程試用，不是實驗室出貨。書記仍在迴路中，正確性與公文書責任仍在地方，轉發本身沒有解決。

brief_en: No new flagship model shipped in the window. Musk said SpaceXAI will become SpaceXSI and amplified a tied Grok 4.7 cyber score, while Farmersville’s clerk-reviewed minutes trial stayed small. Anthropic began an opt-in voice-training ask, and Washington plus New York City moved AI oversight toward a Monday hearing.
brief_zh: 窗口內無新旗艦模型。馬斯克稱將把 SpaceXAI 改名 SpaceXSI，並強調 Grok 4.7 網路分數並列第一；Farmersville 會議紀錄仍由書記複核。Anthropic 開放語音訓練選擇加入，紐約市週一將聽證。
